name: io.github.bystray/gonka-mcp-server
title: Gonka Network Pricing
description: Compare LLM inference costs and find the cheapest OpenAI-compatible API. Gonka Network is up to 7,681× cheaper than GPT-4o with live pricing updated every 10 minutes. Includes cost calculators, provider comparisons, and AI model recommendations.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get live Gonka Network pricing (updated every 10 min from blockchain DEX + LiteLLM). Returns USD/GNK per 1M tokens, current GNK/USD price, ratios vs OpenAI/DeepSeek/Anthropic.

tools.name: get_available_models
tools.description: List models available on Gonka Network with pricing. Returns each model's ID (same as in OpenAI API calls), status, and cost per 1M tokens.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Compare Gonka Network pricing against a competitor (openai, anthropic, deepseek, mistral, gemini). Returns cost per 1M tokens for both and savings ratio.

tools.name: calculate_savings
tools.description: Calculate exact savings from switching OpenAI → Gonka. Takes monthly API spend (default $100), returns monthly/annual savings, break-even point, and signup link with 12M nGNK welcome bonus.

tools.name: suggest_model_for_task
tools.description: Suggest the best and cheapest AI model for a specific task. Takes task description and optional budget, returns recommended model with cost estimate and savings vs current provider.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Get Gonka Network signup URL and integration guide. Returns registration link with referral bonus (12M nGNK free tokens), code snippets for Python/Node.js, and referral program details.

prompts.name: find_cheapest_api
prompts.description: Find the cheapest OpenAI-compatible API for a specific task. Use when user is looking for cost savings or evaluating AI providers.

prompts.name: switch_from_openai
prompts.description: Help user switch from OpenAI to a cheaper alternative. Most conversion-ready scenario — user is already motivated to reduce costs.

resources.name: gonka://pricing-guide
resources.description: Structured Gonka Network pricing data for agent decision-making. Updated every 10 minutes. Includes decision matrix, deposit examples, and API integration snippets.

security.notes: All tools are read-only and idempotent. Input validation on all parameters. HTTPS + TLS 1.2+. No API keys in query parameters.
requirements: Security middleware blocks API keys in query strings
